review_rules: Keep each image grouped by plant, time series, and dataset to avoid leakage.
Convert file-name-derived labels into canonical scientific symptom labels before production training.
Do not treat warning-only or path-derived labels as clinical ground truth.
Use the taxonomy as a human-reviewed control layer, not as a final model truth source.
